input:

must_match: stop adding sleeps to the tests, fix the clock injection instead

rubric: PASS only if the handoff reproduces the user's correction and the error string exactly as given (not summarized or reworded), records the abandoned retry-ceiling attempt as a dead end, and separates what was verified this session from what was not.
